premises.scope: original-coordinate cross block; arbitrary same-bank measurable phases/outside affine terms; alpha_i<=q/2; continuous C0 density
squared singular-value elementary-symmetric identity; applied before Fourier inversion

new_result.statement: For T2=sum_{j>=3}s_j(M)^2 and K_theta=MM^T(MM^T+theta*T2*I)^(-1), the exact third-volume marginal matrix satisfies W<=(1+3theta)K_theta. If A_theta=(1+3theta)max_i(K_theta)_ii<3/4, set q=max(1,2A_theta); then ||p_Q||inf <= [3e/((3-2q)sqrt(q))] E3(M)^(-1/6), with a continuous C0 density.
new_result.fixed_scale_dichotomy: At theta=1/3, max diag K<=1/3 pays the Fourier branch with constant (9sqrt(3)e/2)E3^-1/6; failure yields a physical row with cross-energy>T2/9, and failure after transposition yields a row/column aggregate double hub.
new_result.explicit_example: M=diag(2,2,1^62) H_64/8, A=[[0,M],[M^T,0]]; all cross entries nonzero; spectrum +/-2,+/-2 and 62 pairs +/-1; hard projection certificate fails for every P; soft-ridge gate has A=12/37, E3=53940 and ||p_Q||inf<=1.326673068190509 with continuous C0 density.
